_how_to_edit: Change the text or numbers between the quotes and save. Keep every comma, quote and bracket where it is.
Prices are written as you want them shown, for example "£8".
In the summary sentences, {event-pass}, {pro} and {vendor-pro} are replaced by that plan's price automatically.
To show a banner at the top of every page, set "show" to true and write the text. Links must start with https:// or /.
If the file has a mistake, the site quietly uses its built-in settings, so nothing breaks. Check the change on the live site after saving.
Founding offer dates are in the "founding" section. Both are pending (empty) until you are ready to launch.
Enterprise is priced by quote: it has no buy button, only an "Ask for a quote" form that comes to hello@beshowready.co.uk and into admin Contacts.

pricingSummary.faq: Everything is free during the pilot, which runs until 1 May 2027. After that, planning stays free forever. Suppliers pay from {vendor-pro} a month to be listed and receive enquiries, and organisers can add paid extras. Annual plans save about two months. See Pricing above for the details.

_help: goLiveDate: the public launch day, YYYY-MM-DD. Set to 2027-05-01.

Founding places are limited by number, not by date: the first 100 suppliers and 100 Film & TV accounts to save a profile or project, and the first 100 organisers to upgrade to a paid plan (basic planning is always free). The live counts come from the database (app_settings founding_cap, early_cap, early_deadline, early_discount_pct).
When a category's 100 founding places are taken, the next 200 in that category get the early-adopter offer if they claim by the early_deadline (31 August 2027).
closesOn and autoCloseMonths are no longer used.
A real limit must be honoured: never reset counts or extend the deadline more than once, as that can count as fake urgency under consumer law.
founding.openText: Limited to the first 100 suppliers, 100 Film & TV accounts and 100 organisers who upgrade to a paid plan. Basic planning stays free for organisers.
founding.closedText: Founding places are full. Early adopters who join by 31 August 2027 get 20% off for life (excludes Enterprise).
founding.bannerText: Founding places: the first 100 suppliers, 100 Film & TV accounts and 100 organisers who upgrade get 6 months free, then 30% off for life (excludes Enterprise).

_help: Direct links to council forms, by council. The key is the council's short name in lower case (as postcodes.io names it, e.g. tameside).

For each council you can give: ten, licensing, events, parks, roadClosure, streetTrading. Each has url and label; events and roadClosure can also have weeks (notice needed) and note (one sentence shown on the plan).
Update checked (YYYY-MM-DD) whenever you confirm the links still work. Councils not listed fall back to GOV.UK links.

events.note: Tameside asks for its event notification form at least 8 weeks before the event, emailed to licensing@tameside.gov.uk.

roadClosure.label: Tameside: event road closure application
roadClosure.note: Road closure application at least 6 weeks before, sent with the event notification. £32 admin fee.

accounts._note: Sign-up and log-in (Supabase). Set enabled to false to hide the Sign in button everywhere. Only the public anon key belongs here, never the service_role key.

ads._note: Google AdSense anchor ad along the bottom, for visitors not on a paid plan. Leave enabled false until AdSense approves beshowready.co.uk, then paste your publisher ID (ca-pub- followed by numbers) into client and set enabled to true. Also upload ads.txt (see README).

maps._note: Site plan maps. maptilerKey: MapTiler public key (aerial photos and street map). esriKey: paste an Esri (ArcGIS Location Platform) API key restricted to beshowready.co.uk to use Esri's sharper aerial photos; leave empty to use MapTiler.

billing._note: Turn on when Stripe is connected: set enabled to true. Until then pricing shows no buy buttons and everything stays free.

social._note: Paste each full profile address (https://...) here once the profile is live, then rebuild. Empty ones are skipped.

ticketing._note: Ticketing step on the planner's Suppliers tab, for ticketed (paid entry) events only. Never shown to visitors who came from a council link. Change the links here; set enabled to false to hide it.
